hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Raleigh, North Carolina as headquarters; the funding announcement also describes Levitate as Raleigh-based.

public_docs.notes: Levitate has a public Help Center with multiple product and integration articles.

raised_18mo.notes: Levitate announced a $16 million funding round on March 5, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: Both company profile and Our Story identify 2017.

last_funding.notes: The March 2026 announcement reports $16 million; Caplight identifies the latest round as Series E.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 25, 2026, Levitate announced four new AI features, within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: Plans are publicly described, though core platform pricing requires contacting sales.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company in the 201-500 employee band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Greenhouse board lists open Sales Development Representative and Manager, Account Executive roles.

model_provider.notes: Levitate publicly names Anthropic PBC, Google LLC, and OpenAI, LLC as underlying AI model providers.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are named among the company's customer success stories.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Greenhouse board lists open positions but none of the listed role titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

compliance_certs.notes: Levitate says it completes an annual SOC 2 audit and has announced SOC 2 Type I and Type II certification. HIPAA readiness is not listed as a certification.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These CRM systems are explicitly listed among Levitate's integrations.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies it as built for small businesses and says AI helps users know who needs attention, what to say, and when to reach out.
product_one_liner.value: Levitate is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and marketing platform that helps small, relationship-based businesses stay in touch with clients and prospects through personalized outreach.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available team page identifies current leadership but provides no dates of joining, and no verifiable dated announcement of a C-level or VP-level arrival or departure was found.
